tools.name: page-to-text
tools.description: Fetches a public web page and returns its readable text as JSON: url, status, title, char count, and clean text with scripts, styles and tags stripped. Blocks private/localhost addresses. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/page-to-t

tools.name: json-check
tools.description: Validates a JSON document sent as the raw request body and returns it pretty-printed. Returns valid true/false, the formatted JSON, a count of keys, and byte size. Invalid JSON returns the parser error message. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orch

tools.name: text-stats
tools.description: Send plain text as the raw POST body and get back word count, sentence count, character count, estimated reading minutes, and the top 10 keywords (stopwords removed). Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/text-stats.

tools.name: hash-encode
tools.description: POST raw text as the body and get back its byte count, sha256, sha1, md5, hex, base64 and base64url encodings. Useful for checksums, IDs and encoding a value mid-task. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xyz/t/hash-encode.

tools.name: csv-to-json
tools.description: POST raw CSV as the body (first row is headers) and get back a JSON array of row objects, plus column names and row count. Handles quoted fields, commas and newlines inside quotes, and escaped quotes. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402 at https://tools.orchardshop.xy

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: POST titles as JSON {"titles": [...]} or as raw text with one title per line, and get back URL-safe slugs. Strips accents, lowercases, removes apostrophes and collapses other punctuation to single hyphens. Up to 500 titles per call. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per call via x402

tools.name: json-to-csv
tools.description: POST a JSON array of flat objects (or {"rows":[...]}) and get CSV back. Columns are the union of all keys in order of first appearance. Values are quoted and escaped per RFC 4180. Nested objects are stored as JSON text. Up to 5000 rows per call. Free: 3 calls a day per visitor; after that $0.01 per

tools.name: markdown-strip
tools.description: POST raw markdown as the request body and get plain text back. Removes headings, emphasis, links (keeps the label), images (keeps the alt text), list markers, blockquotes, HTML tags and code fences (keeps code contents). Useful before summarizing or indexing markdown documents. Free: 3 calls a day p

tools.name: page-to-markdown
tools.description: Fetches any public http(s) page and returns clean Markdown: headings (#), paragraphs, lists, links with absolute URLs, bold/italic, and code blocks. Scripts, styles and nav/footer are removed. Output is capped at the first 50,000 characters, with a truncated flag. Blocks localhost and private addres

tools.name: page-metadata
tools.description: Fetches any public http(s) page and returns its metadata: title, meta description, canonical URL, favicon URL, all OpenGraph (og:*) properties, and every unique absolute link with its anchor text (up to 500). Blocks localhost and private addresses. Returns JSON with url, final_url, status, title, de

tools.name: rss-latest
tools.description: Fetches any public RSS 2.0 or Atom feed and returns its latest items as JSON, newest first in feed order. Each item has title, link, published date, summary (first 500 chars, tags stripped) and guid. Choose how many with ?limit= (1-50, default 10). Blocks localhost and private addresses. Returns JSO

tools.name: site-crawl-markdown
tools.description: Crawls one public website breadth-first from a start URL, staying on the same hostname, and returns each page as clean Markdown (up to 20,000 chars per page). Reads robots.txt and skips disallowed paths, fetches at most 2 pages at a time with about 300ms between requests, and identifies as OrchardBo

tools.name: sitemap-to-index
tools.description: Reads a website's sitemap.xml and returns each page's title, meta description and word count as JSON. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: json-check, text-stats, hash-encode, csv-to-json, slugify, json-to-csv, markdown-strip, site-crawl-markdown, bulk-page-to-markdown, site-audit · Private data: page-to-text, json-check, markdown-strip, page-to-markdown, page-metadata, rss-latest, site-crawl-markdown · Public sink: text-stats, hash-encode, csv-to-json, slugify, json-to-csv, markdown-strip · Destructive: rss-latest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: json-check, text-stats, hash-encode, csv-to-json, slugify, json-to-csv, markdown-strip, site-crawl-markdown, bulk-page-to-markdown, site-audit · Private data: page-to-text, json-check, markdown-strip, page-to-markdown, page-metadata, rss-latest, site-crawl-markdown · Public sink: text-stats, hash-encode, csv-to-json, slugify, json-to-csv, markdown-strip · Destructive: rss-latest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
